message:
Review of the almanac update (proposed version 3, file name almanac-2026-12-01-v3.md). Nothing is saved yet.

Sources: 17 files processed, 0 excluded. The audio recording (board-meeting-2026-06-18.m4a) was transcribed, not sent to document extraction.

Changelog (v2 to v3):

1. Changed, evidence only: Pets. The corrected minutes (minutes-2025-04-15.docx) say the pet-rule vote was 2-1, not 3-0 as first recorded. Rule, scope, effective date (2025-04-15) and status are unchanged, so the summary comparison would not flag this on its own; I am showing it here. Quote: "Corrected copy, approved by the board on November 20, 2026. It replaces the earlier copy: the vote on item 2 was 2-1, not 3-0 as first recorded."

2. No rule changed. Every topic in At a glance matches v2 in rule, since-date, scheduled change and status.

3. Open items: three rows added (landscaping outcome not established; the next notice point if the contract renewed, calculated and not stated in a document; the 2026 pool hours question). No existing open item changed owner, due date or status.

Previous At a glance values, for reference: Pets, up to 2 per unit, since 2025-04-15, adopted. Monthly fee $240, since 2026-03-01, adopted. The other topics also match v2.

Conflict (1):
- Pool and amenities, 2026 season. Minutes 2025-09-10 (3-0): "for the 2026 season the pool is open 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. daily." Notice 2026-05-01: "Hours: 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. daily." Under the rules a notice does not replace an adopted decision, so this stays a conflict. Other seasons follow the bylaws, 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., June 1 to September 15.

Provisional items (2), from the recording only:
- Electric barbecues: the board leaned towards allowing them, no vote taken, motion planned for September. The 2026-09-15 minutes contain no barbecue record. The bylaws prohibition still stands.
- The pool hours objection ("Someone said the notice says nine pm, but I thought we said ten"), deferred with no vote.

Vendor contracts remain incomplete: the minutes set a notice deadline of 2026-01-30 and the notice is dated 2026-02-02. The documents do not establish whether the agreement ended or renewed.

Exclusions: none.

Approval: shall I save this as almanac-2026-12-01-v3.md in the Almanac folder? Reply yes to save, or tell me which passage was misread. If you decline, I will stop and save nothing.
